correctness.rationale: Laplace functional for independent turns on [epsilon,1] converges to PPP intensity c du/u because k p_k->c. Fair terminal orientation is independent of turn flags, so the integrated parity walk has the specified stationary telegraph-filter joint limit. Stationary transport zero-flux yields p_s(y)=(1+s y)C(1-y²)^(c-1)/2, giving Beta moments/Binder. For rational p_k the zero-flip product over k=2..n gives the claimed gamma quotient; finite n=10 own exact-product test was 40353607/387420489. Critical path and its consequences are however prior mathematics.
residual_risks: Potential delta at p_1 is harmless because initial sign fair; no endpoint mass in limit; finite checks do not substitute for convergence.
